en: You be too scared!  Me find you!
Finally!! I can leave this dump.
Let the legend of Stalvan rest!
Huh?  What do you want?

Even as we speak, $c, all of the war materiel is being transported over to Silithus. By the looks of things, the last of it should arrive in less than a day. After that, a $g hero : heroine; will need to come along and ring the gong at the Scarab Dais. Then the war will begin in earnest.
I have lost my Signet of the Unseen Path. Are you able to replace it for me?
Remember, if I faint again, the water that Spraggle gave you will revive me.
%s dissipates into the ether, his howling winds still ringing in your ears.

Valstann, eager to please his father, convinced Fandral to allow him to take a small battalion to the defense of Southwind. Surely with the tide of battle turning their way, no harm could come to his beloved child. The trap was missed. Valstann was captured by the hiding Qiraji and Southwind Village obliterated. Rajaxx himself would take the captive Valstann to the front lines of the battle where - in front of Staghelm and the night elf forces - he would brutally execute the young night elf.
Oh no!  Here they come!
This has gone too far.  How dare the Scourge attack Stormwind!  Destroy it before more come!
Some of this ointment should help.
We have enough supplies to launch a ground assault.  If you want to deliver those orders, and you think you qualify, then speak with Corporal Noreg Stormpike.
The secrets hidden within the Pylons of Un'Goro Crater are now yours. Visit the Pylons at any time to access their power and gain useful resources.
If I was not bound by duty to Master Ravenholdt, I would follow you to the ends of the world, $G Master:Mistress; $n. You are grace and cunning personified.
Hello, citizen.  You look like a $gman:woman; with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?
Well $glad : lass;, ye can find Shelby Stoneflint right outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.  She'll take good care of any pets ye might have.
%s abandons the block he was holding up in the doorway, and looks towards the bait.
%s enters a trance...
So let me get this straight. You were swimming, nay, doing backstrokes in molten lava with this... this lava suit of yours? Yes? And out of nowhere, this here beast swallowed you whole?
%s disappears into the woods.
Battle!  I can smell your fear, $c!
My lord will be outraged to learn of this ambush.  Let us hope your death will appease him.
IF they say... IF!  There are no if's about Ironforge!  Eh?  What now?
Hello, $n. I train and care for young hippogryphs here; feel free to have a look around.
Throm'ka $c!  Are you ready to fight for the Horde at Warsong Gulch?
Keep your foes at bay and carve them into cutlets at the same time. The only problem is that the long shaft keeps me from getting blood on my hands.
Ewwwww... not if you were the last orc on Kalimdor, Lunk.
The Stormpike Aid Station is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will capture it!
%s nervously crawls from the crate.
We have gathered a lot of supplies for rebuilding, but we still need a lot more in order to repair Dun Baldar.  Keep bringing me supplies!
We'll not let this act of madness go unpunished!
Defend the barricade!
May I have another Dawn's Gambit, Betina?  I want to test it again...

The tides of war have come again. From the cold north, the Lich King's necropolises have laid siege to our lands.  He and his cursed general, Kel'Thuzad, send flying necropolises to invade across the world.
Here here!
%s leaps from the first catapult to the second!

Vanndar Stormpike is the general of the Alliance military in Alterac, and directs his forces from Dun Baldar.$B$BIf he is defeated then the Alliance will surely lose the battle for Alterac.$B$BVanndar is not currently in Alterac Valley.
The Stormpike Graveyard is cut into the mountains, across the bridge east of Dun Baldar.$B$BThe Horde currently controls it.
Ysida lives thanks to your courage, $n.  I am deeply in your debt and shall assist you as much as it is in my power.
Oh, a priest is it?  Well good ol' Maxan is sure to be found having a drink in the Thunderbrew Distillery if ye need a bit of training.
The world is indebted to you and your allies, $n.
My $g Lord:Lady;, please allow me to live long enough to see you purge this world of the infidels.
I can make it from here.  Thanks, $n!  And talk to my employer about a reward!
Give me one of your magic items.
A slippery tile causes you to lose your footing.

These once beautiful woods suffer under a terrible curse!  Corrupting forces twist the life here into shadows of their former selves.  If you are not an agent of this corruption, then perhaps you can aid me in reclaiming Felwood!
I guess so!
